title: Extraction of Scapharca broughtonii genomic DNA
author: Chang-Ming CM Bai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zhaf32e
materials: Pipet 700 µl mixture from step 6 into the DNeasy Mini spin column* placed in a 2 ml collection tube*. Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 30 sec at 4℃. Discard flow-through and collection tube. *: these items were provided by Qiagen DNeasy® Blood & Tissue kit (Catalog no. 69504)

steps.title: Harvest haemocytes
steps.instruction: Collect 1 mL haemocyte into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, centrifuge at 1000 g for 10 min at 4 ℃, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 200 µL PBS.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL and RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer AL (Qiagen DNeasy® Blood & Tissue kit, Cat. 69504) and 20 µL RNase A, vortex thoroughly, then incubate at room temperature for 3–5 min.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and SDS
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL proteinase K (Qiagen DNeasy® Blood & Tissue kit, Cat. 69504), vortex, incubate at 56 ℃ for 15 min; then add 10 % SDS, continue incubation at 56 ℃ for another 15 min.

steps.title: Extract with cold chloroform
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of cold chloroform (4 ℃), invert to mix, and let stand at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Phase separation by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 g for 10 min at 4 ℃ and transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1/3 volume absolute ethanol to the transferred supernatant and invert to mix.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column (first wash)
steps.instruction: Place a DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1 (Qiagen DNeasy® Blood & Tissue kit, Cat. 69504), centrifuge at 12 000 g for 30 s at 4 ℃, discard flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash spin column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2 (Qiagen DNeasy® Blood & Tissue kit, Cat. 69504), centrifuge at 12 000 g for 30 s at 4 ℃, discard flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Repeat Buffer AW2 wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step: add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge 30 s at 12 000 g, discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Dry spin column membrane
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge at 12 000 g for 2 min at 4 ℃, then leave the column at room temperature for 10 min to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, pipet 50 µL Buffer AE onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 1 min, and centrifuge for 1 min at 12 000 g to collect the eluate.
